metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the real-estate-erp-platform domain, modeled on Bloxs and the acquired Informant Software: a vertical ERP for real estate investors, asset managers, property managers and owners' association administrators covering portfolio and relations, letting and contracts, finance and rent, technical management, owners' associations, insight and portals, and the platform foundation of hyper automation, AI assistants, open API, identity, workflow and migration tooling.

bricks.name: Objects, Complexes and Units
bricks.description: System of record for the physical and legal portfolio: legal entities and their ownership shares, portfolios, complexes, buildings and every rental unit of every type — residential, commercial, retail, logistics, healthcare, parking and storage — with addresses, cadastral references, surfaces, energy labels, unit characteristics and status (let, vacant, in renovation, sold). Bloxs' Objecten module lives here; every other brick keys contracts, invoices, tickets, plans and analytics on the object and unit identifiers it publishes, which is what makes portals, robots and dashboards compound instead of bolt on.
